description: This file configures and exports a pre-configured Axios instance for making HTTP requests to a backend API. It includes functions for URL normalization, environment-specific URL resolution, token handling, and request/response interceptors for handling authentication tokens and refresh logic.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL or path string.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1'.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is inside the Kavia preview environment based on hostname.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the public origin URL during Kavia preview based on window location.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable URLs, handling relative paths, proxy URLs, and fixing common misconfigurations.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL used by Axios, considering environment variables, Kavia preview, and default fallback.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL if present.
